title: Config Safety Net: causal-trace rollback, transient patching, and economic rebalancer
creator: Priya Nair
description: Deliver an automated safety net for config changes that (1) identifies the causal config change for regressions using causal tracing, (2) applies a transient patch rollback that isolates the faulty change without impacting unrelated routes, and (3) triggers an "economic rebalancer" that temporarily adjusts batching/caching knobs to limit cost exposure while preserving latency SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Causal tracing can attribute >=90% of detected cost/latency regressions to a single config change within 5 minutes of detection
Transient rollback can be applied to a single traffic route or tenant without requiring a full fleet rollback

Economic rebalancer adjusts batching/window/cache TTLs automatically and reduces token cost spend by at least 30% in simulated cost-spike scenarios while keeping P95 latency within configured SLO degradation tolerance
State reconciliation completes within configured hysteresis window and reports a deterministic final state; no drifting stale config remains after automated recoveries
End-to-end E2E test harness exists that simulates config changes, induces regressions, and validates rollback and reconciliation paths
implementation_notes: Add a lightweight causal tracer that correlates config diffs (git hash + feature flags) with metric deltas using weighted attribution over request traces and short-term rollout timelines
Expose a 'transient patch' API that toggles only the affected route/model-worker combination; implement as a prioritized overlay in the routing layer to avoid synchronous deploys

Economic rebalancer runs as a short-lived policy executor: it samples load, evaluates cost vs latency models, and can atomically update batching.batch_size, batching.max_wait_ms, and cache.prefix_ttl for affected routes
Maintain audit trail: every automatic action must produce a deterministic undo token and be logged to the audit store with links to the causal trace and metrics snapshot
Integrate with existing rollout engine for safety: when the sentinel fires, create a canary rollback plan and optionally escalate to on-call via PagerDuty if automated measures fail
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): feature-flagged tracer + manual operator view; run in read-only to validate attribution for 2 weeks
Phase 2 (soft-automate): enable transient rollback for internal routes only; economic rebalancer runs in simulate mode (no writes) and produces recommended config diffs
Phase 3 (automated): enable auto-apply for low-risk routes with strict throttles and kill-switch flags; require two-step confirmation for global rollbacks
Phase 4 (global): expand to customer-facing routes with full telemetry-driven thresholds and on-call escalation rules
test_plan: Unit tests for tracer logic and attribution thresholds
Integration tests: synthetic load harness that injects a config diff and validates attribution and transient rollback path
Chaos tests: randomly flip config overlays during sustained traffic and verify reconciliation converges
Cost regressions bench: run economic rebalancer against historical production traces in staging to validate cost/loss tradeoffs
Security review and pen-test on transient overlay API before Phase 3
observability_requirements: Metric hooks: config-change events, tracer attribution score, rollback actions, reconciliation success/failure, economic rebalancer decisions
Dashboards: per-route cost delta, P95 latency, tracer hit-rate, automated-action audit log with links to traces
Alerting: automated-action-failure (P1), attribution-uncertain (P2), repeated flapping detected (P1)
comments: 2025-02-15 Priya Nair: Initial scope drafted. Decided to prioritise transient overlays over full rollback to avoid cascading impact on unrelated routes.
2025-02-21 Ethan Park: Implemented prototype tracer using request sample correlation. Early results show good signal for model-routing changes but noise for autoscaling knobs — need smoothing window.
2025-02-28 Olga Kuznetsov (SRE): Reviewed prototype. Concern: transient overlay should avoid bypassing tenant-level RBAC. Recommend audit tokens and RBAC checks on apply API.
2025-03-02 Design review (Sofia Martinez): UX for operator console should highlight causal confidence score and provide single-click transient rollback with preflight checks.
2025-03-04 QA: Integration harness completed. Simulated cost spike test reduced spend 38% after rebalancer decisions; P95 increased by 12% but within tolerance for non-critical routes.
2025-03-05 Ethan Park: Merged initial PR for transient overlay API behind feature flag; enabling read-only tracer in staging this week. Next: integrate economic model for batching tradeoffs.

2025-03-01 In Progress -> In Review: internal design + SRE feedback addressed
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False attribution could rollback innocent changes -> Mitigation: require confidence threshold and multi-window corroboration before auto-apply
Risk: Rebalancer oscillation affecting latency -> Mitigation: hysteresis and minimum hold time for applied adjustments; simulate mode for 24h before auto-enforce
Risk: Security exposure from overlay API -> Mitigation: RBAC, signed audit tokens, and KMS-backed change signing
